payload.title: File:Paul Sereno with Sinornithomimus.jpg
payload.description_html:
Paleontologist Paul Sereno is the first speaker in OSU's 2010-11 Horning Lecture Series. Here, he holds a plaque cast of two juvenile skeletons of the ostrich-mimic dinosaur Sinornithomimus that died when they were a little over one year in age. Sept. 2010.
Photo by Mike Hettwer, courtesy of Project Exploration.
